## About this project

This page holds the replication code and the tables for a study of how pension
receipt (old age and widow pension) is related to outpatient and
inpatient healthcare use among Indians aged 60-100, using LASI Wave 1.

## Read the tables

- [Analysis and tables](LASI_analysis.qmd): the full document with all tables.
- [Download the PDF directly](LASI_analysis.pdf)

## Data

LASI microdata cannot be redistributed, so it is not part of this repository.
